title: Character coherence: one human cast, one theme, tied to the design style
problem: There is no plan for how the characters look and read as a whole. Today there are three kinds of cast under one word (6 animal shopkeepers, 4 start icons, 39 customers of whom 10 are not human and 8 wear costumes), drawn in three ways, and the owner wants everyone human under one coherent theme tied to the design style.
scope: The owner decides the theme (DEC-039) and whether the shopkeepers become humans (DEC-040); no art or code changes before that

Retheme or redraw the customers the theme changes; six human shopkeepers if approved; check the four start icons
The screen, the printed cards, the character pick and the gallery all draw the same portraits from the same data
Optional, owner decides: idle, happy and sad frames
exclusions: Changing any perk, order or rule
New customers beyond replacements the owner asks for
